title: ICE Flight Monitor Interactive Dashboard
content:
Amidst flagrant abuses by ICE, inhumane detention, and deportations without due process, ICE Flight Monitor delivers data to strengthen public accountability and uphold transparency in our democracy.

This interactive dashboard is intended to offer a dynamic view of ICE Air flights tracked by the project, enabling users to visualize common routes, weekly patterns of shuffle and deportation flights, third country transfer flights, and track historical flight trends dating back to 2020.

Navigating the interactive dashboard: use the drop-down menus on the left to filter by month and location. For more granular analysis, click any data point in a visual to cross-filter the other elements on the page. Clear all filters at any time by clicking “Clear all filters.” To navigate between pages, select the title tab at the top of each page.

This dashboard will be updated on a rolling basis; the date of last update can be found in the bottom left. Please note that identifying flights requires a multi-layered process. To ensure the accuracy and integrity of the findings, we cross-reference flight data with various sources, and therefore, some retroactive edits to data may be made as new findings arise.
